# avnu Developers

## Docs

- [Cancel DCA Order](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/dca/cancel-order.md): Generate calldata to cancel an active DCA order and return remaining funds
- [Create DCA Order](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/dca/create-order.md): Generate calldata to create a dollar-cost averaging order on-chain
- [Get DCA Orders](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/dca/get-orders.md): Retrieve all DCA orders for a specific trader address
- [Get Market Data](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/get-market-data.md): Retrieve market data for all popular tokens on Starknet
- [Get Token Market Data](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/get-token-market-data.md): Retrieve detailed market data for a specific token
- [Get OHLCV Data](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/ohlcv.md): Retrieve candlestick (OHLCV) data for technical analysis and charting
- [Get Price Feed](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/price-feed.md): Retrieve historical price data for charting and analysis
- [Get Transfer Volume](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/transfer-volume.md): Retrieve historical transfer volume data over time
- [Get TVL by Exchanges](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/tvl-by-exchange.md): Retrieve TVL (Total Value Locked) distribution across exchanges
- [Get TVL Feed](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/tvl-feed.md): Retrieve historical TVL data by exchange over time
- [Get Volume by Exchange](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/volume-by-exchange.md): Retrieve trading volume distribution across exchanges
- [Get Volume Feed](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/markets/volume-feed.md): Retrieve historical trading volume data by exchange over time
- [Overview](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/overview.md): REST API documentation for avnu services
- [Monitor Sponsor Activity](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/paymaster/sponsor-activity.md): Monitor your API key's sponsorship metrics and remaining credits
- [Get Current Prices](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/prices/get-prices.md): Fetch real-time prices for multiple tokens with Global and Starknet data
- [Claim Rewards](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/claim-rewards.md): Claim accumulated staking rewards
- [Claim Withdraw](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/claim-withdraw.md): Claim unbonded STRK after 21-day period
- [Get Member](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/get-member.md): Get user's staking position and rewards
- [Get Staking Info](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/get-pools.md): Get overall staking information and delegation pools
- [Initiate Withdraw](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/initiate-withdraw.md): Start unstaking process (21-day unbonding)
- [Stake](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/staking/stake.md): Deposit STRK to earn staking rewards
- [Build Swap Calls](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/swap/build-swap.md): Get transaction calls to execute a swap
- [Get Swap Quotes](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/swap/get-quotes.md): Fetch optimized swap quotes across all Starknet liquidity sources
- [Get Sources](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/swap/get-sources.md): List all supported liquidity sources
- [Get Token](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/tokens/get-token.md): Fetch detailed information for a specific token
- [Get Tokens](https://docs.avnu.fi/api/tokens/get-tokens.md): Fetch paginated list of tokens with optional filtering
- [Overview](https://docs.avnu.fi/docs/dca/index.md): Automate recurring token purchases on Starknet
- [Integration Guide](https://docs.avnu.fi/docs/dca/integration-guide.md): Recurring Buy integration guide
- [Overview](https://docs.avnu.fi/docs/index.md): Complete documentation for building on avnu

- [Get Price Feed](https://docs.avnu.fi/docs/markets/get-price-feed.md): Fetch historical price data for charting and analysis using the SDK
